project_level_bootstrap_2000_resamples.caveat: Resampled over only 6 test projects (1 vulnerable); intervals are wide and should be read as low-power/descriptive, not as evidence of a precise effect size.

mcnemar_svm_vs_late_fusion_test.finding: Zero discordant pairs: SVM-only and late-fusion produced IDENTICAL predictions on all 8 test samples (both predict SAFE for every sample, including the true positive). No paired significance test is applicable when there is no disagreement between the two methods being compared -- this is itself the finding, not a null result to explain away.

risk_coverage_aurc_test.caveat: n=8, 1 positive -- LOW_POWER/DESCRIPTIVE, not a robust AURC estimate
